title: Senior HR Recruiter
description:
We’re Hiring:
 **Senior HR Recruiter / HR Manager** 




 📍 Location: Barasat
 



 🎓 Experience: 5–8 Years (Senior\-Level HR \& Recruitment)
 



 🎓 Qualification: Master’s Degree (HR / Management / Related Field)
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for an experienced and strategic HR professional who can independently handle end\-to\-end recruitment for non\-teaching staff and also contribute to designing, developing, and implementing HR policies. The role requires a strong understanding of institutional hiring, stakeholder management, and HR best practices.
 



 This position demands a proactive leader who can manage recruitment operations efficiently while also supporting HR policy frameworks and organizational development initiatives.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 • Lead end\-to\-end recruitment for non\-teaching roles (administrative, technical, operational, and support staff)
 



 • Develop and execute effective hiring strategies aligned with institutional needs
 



 • Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle: sourcing, screening, interviewing, selection, negotiation, and onboarding
 



 • Build and maintain strong talent pipelines for current and future requirements
 



 • Partner with departments for manpower planning and workforce requirements
 



 • Assist in designing, updating, and implementing HR policies and procedures
 



 • Maintain recruitment MIS, dashboards, and hiring reports
 



 • Ensure timely closure of positions with quality hiring outcomes
 



 • Support HR compliance and process improvement initiatives
 



  





**What We’re Looking For** 




 • Master’s degree in HR, Management, or related discipline
 



 • 5–10 years of proven experience in recruitment and HR management
 



 • Strong exposure to non\-teaching / institutional recruitment preferred
 



 • Experience in HR policy formulation and implementation is essential
 



 • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and negotiation skills
 



 • Strong command over sourcing tools, LinkedIn, and job portals
 



 • Ability to handle multiple priorities and work under deadlines
 



 • Self\-driven, detail\-oriented, and result\-focused approach
 



  





**Why Join Us** 




 • Opportunity to work in a reputed academic institution
 



 • Exposure to strategic HR policy development and implementation
 



 • Work closely with leadership on key HR initiatives
 



 • Growth\-oriented and impact\-driven work environment
 



  





**How To Apply:** 




 If interested, please drop your CV and a cover page to
 **tulika.hr@brainwareuniversity.ac.in** 




 📞 Queries:
 **033 69010651/9093402878**

title: US IT Recruiter Sales- Night Shift -US Process - Fresher are welcome
description:
Role Description This full\-time, on\-site US IT Recruiter Sales role is based in Rajarhat and operates in a night shift to support the US process. The role involves handling the full recruitment lifecycle for IT positions, including sourcing, screening, and shortlisting candidates through job portals, social media, networking, and referrals. The recruiter will coordinate interviews, negotiate compensation, and manage offers while maintaining strong relationships with candidates and clients. Daily responsibilities include collaborating closely with the sales and account management teams to understand client requirements, prioritizing open positions, and ensuring timely delivery of qualified candidates. The role also requires maintaining accurate recruitment records, meeting performance targets, and contributing to a professional, inclusive workplace environment.
   

 Qualifications
   

  

 Candidates should possess skills in Full\-life Cycle Recruiting, Recruiting, and Hiring.
   

 Candidates should possess skills in IT Recruitment and Technical Recruiting.
   

 Strong understanding of US staffing practices, time zones, and employment terms (W2, C2C, 1099\).
   

 Excellent spoken and written communication skills in English, with the ability to build rapport with clients and candidates.
   

 Proven experience working in night shifts or supporting US\-based processes is preferred.
   

 Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment, manage multiple requisitions, and meet targets and deadlines.
   

 Proficiency with applicant tracking systems (ATS), major job boards, and professional networking platforms.
   

 Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Human Resources, Business, or a related field is beneficial.

title: Career Process Association - Night Shift -US Process
description:
**Company Description** 
 V Engineering LLC is a leading staffing organization focused on connecting businesses with the right talent across diverse industries. With more than a decade of experience, the company has built a strong global client and candidate base and maintains a high customer retention rate. Its team of trained professionals uses advanced tools and methods to bridge gaps between employers and job seekers. V Engineering LLC emphasizes a values\-driven work culture and strong ethics, striving to deliver long\-term, successful placements.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Career Process Associate – Night Shift – US Process will work full time on\-site at the Rajarhat office. This role involves supporting candidates through the career process, including understanding their profiles, discussing career paths, and guiding them through application, interview, and onboarding stages. The associate will handle inbound and outbound communication with candidates and clients in the US, provide timely information, and ensure a professional and positive experience. Daily responsibilities include maintaining accurate records, analyzing candidate fit for roles, coordinating with internal teams, and delivering high\-quality customer service during night shift hours. The role also requires adherence to company policies, process guidelines, and performance targets.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong Career Counseling and Career Development skills to guide individuals through role selection and growth opportunities.
* Candidates should possess excellent Communication abilities, including clear spoken and written English suitable for US\-based clients and candidates.
* Candidates should possess solid Analytical Skills to assess candidate profiles, match them with suitable roles, and interpret process\-related data.
* Candidates should possess proven Customer Service skills to manage queries, resolve issues, and maintain a positive experience throughout the staffing process.
* Comfort with night shift work supporting US processes, with the ability to manage time and workload efficiently.
* Basic computer proficiency, including use of CRM or applicant tracking systems, email, and office productivity tools.
* Prior experience in staffing, BPO, recruitment, or counseling is an advantage.
* Minimum educational qualification: bachelor’s degree or equivalent; relevant certifications in counseling or HR are beneficial.
